notes.title: Update: Support for scene selection via keyboard inputs and more work on LIV
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

I have added support for scene selection via keyboard inputs. This is a common request from organisations that use Nature Treks VR in care homes and hospital locations.
The nurse, carer or instructor can switch the scenes using the following keyboard inputs.

NOTE: You may need to mouse click in the game window first.

0. Main Menu
1. Blue Moon
2. Turquoise Oasis
3. white waterfall
4. Gray storm
5. Green meadows
6. Blue ocean
7. Red savanna
8. Black beginning
9. White winter
F1. Green bamboo
F2. Blue deep
F3. Orange sunset
F4. Violet dawn
F5. Red fall
F6. Jade Jurassic 
Escape = Quit

I've also fixed LIV mixed reality capture for the main menu. The main menu now uses a single camera.

Thanks
John

notes.title: Update: Integration work for Liv mixed reality capture

Also some work on work on a softer grass shader.

Thanks
John

notes.title: NEW UPDATE RELEASED: The Animal Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/806ddbf1b1d1c641d77624a9f0c181e366f6f065.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/e696bdb5348963ed42353c7ec428cf52837f6ecb.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/ed0fb21d74f802ed4dd80bfb34854cc1b1f1ee8b.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/e01c10b5a2886ffa741063327c90fc5e4590fd8d.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/6b9cfba787890756ef3a4c8f5cf5f9689e896f8c.jpg

Hello Everybody,

The new update is finally ready, its taken longer than originally planned but hopefully it is worth it. Its a mixed bag of improvements and additions, most of them based on common requests, I have tried to listen and do what I can to keep improving the experience. I was planning to launch this next week accompanied by some marketing material and a new trailer but I have decided to release early.

A pass on all animal models has been completed, a number of new animals have also been added bringing the total number of animal encounters in excess of 60. I will be making a guide of all animals featured and where to find them in the next couple of weeks.
A completely new animal behaviour system has been implemented that allows the animals to behave in a more natural manner and lets them herd.
The audio has had a complete overhaul with approximately 80% of the audio effects being replaced. A volumetric audio system has also been incorporated.
The music tracks not ending smoothly has been fixed. A new simplified help panel has been added. An option to disable the audio visualisation elements but retain the music has been added. Icons now appear when toggling options to give some feedback to the user. Several trees have been replaced with higher detail versions (Most pine trees). Added some smaller animals such as dragonflies, wasps. bees and lady bugs.
Two new environments have been added. 'Jade Jurassic' features numerous peaceful herding dinosaurs in a prehistoric valley.
'Gray Storm' aims to provide a more localized experience and includes a Komodo dragon, giant tortoise, geko, iguana and a 'feature event' dragon.
Several incidental interactive objects have been added to 'Gray Storm' such as shells and sticks. This alludes to additional features that will be available in the next project.
There are a few things that didn't make it. Namely a full graphical interface (I tried but it broke everything) and some additional locomotion requests/options that really needed a graphical interface to implement/select them.
Nature Treks VR has become what a large project, now with 15 environments (from an original 8), making adjustments very time consuming. Given that, I have decided to focus additional requests and feedback into the new project which hopefully builds and improves upon the essence of the NTVR experience.

Changes in this update include:

    Added new environment 'Jade Jurassic'
    Added new environment 'Gray Storm'
    Added new audio system
    Added 2 new music tracks
    Added 16 new animals
    Added new animal behaviour system
    Added new help panels
    Added toggle icons
    Fixed bug with music not ending smoothly
    Various other tweaks and fixes


If you have an issues just let me know and I will be sure to take a look. On the flip side if you do enjoy NTVR a positive review is always appreciated, I read them all and its always a positive lift to get a nice one.

Thanks for supporting the project.

-John

notes.title: NEW UPDATE RELEASED: New environment 'Green Bamboo'
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/951e6bb39e0ef31d3d8cdc8a58054c692281f2a0.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/131fec60277c6066d3d5887d46e48cca38450c30.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/df00c556ffd1ad4c6acc3c86dbadc140f847b350.jpg
Hello Everybody,

After the ocean, space and Halloween themes of the last few updates NTVR goes back to its roots with a new tranquil environment 'Green Bamboo'.
Its quite a diverse landscape so hopefully something for everyone, it also includes a new animal, an Asian Tiger.

Now we have a good number and broad variety of environments development will now shift toward improving and building on the fundamental experience.

Changes in this update include:
Added new environment ' Green Bamboo'
Added new animal audio
Added new audio tracks
Fixed some of the color banding in 'Blue Moon'
Fixed the flicking fire glitch affecting rift users

NOTE: If you experience extreme judder for the first few seconds when entering an environment please exit and re-enter or wait for it to settle down. It seems to happen only on first load - looking into the cause.

As always if you have any issues, comments or suggestions please let me 
know and I will be sure to listen and take a look.

Thanks for supporting the project - I really mean it. Its been a great journey so far and given some time I think I can really evolve the essence of the experience.

-John

Hello Everybody,

A new environment has been added. 'Blue Moon' aims to give a haunting 
yet beautiful experience, there are no jump scares here, only your 
imagination. Hopefully it creates a nice atmosphere in time for 
Halloween. This environment is also different from the others in that it 
contains some man made structures. There are also some new animals to be 
found.
NOTE: I've noticed an issue with the flickering fire on the Rift, will try and fix it in the next update.

Some work on the audio visualization FX has been added. Remember if you 
toggle off the music these will also stop appearing.

Aurora Borealis have been added to 'White Winter' if you toggle the time 
of day to night.

Changes in this update include:

    Added new environment ' Blue Moon'
    Added new audio visualisation FX
    Added Aurora Borealis effect to 'White Winter'
    Added new audio tracks
    Removed rim shader from animals
    Slowed down some rolling fog effects
    Fixed issue with the player being to high in scene selection
    Various other minor fixes and tweaks


Another update with a new environment will follow in the near future. It 
will take the shape of a beautiful Asian landscape complete with tigers.

As always if you have any issues, comments or suggestions please let me 
know and I will be sure to listen and take a look.

Thanks for supporting the project.

-John

Hello Everybody,

This new update takes you to the stars with a completely new environment and experience. Create stars, planets and solar systems in a tranquil physics based sandbox experience.
Glide high above the earth, manifest a beautiful comet storm or simply create a spectacular cosmic forest of 'galaxy trees'. 
Failing that just send everything into oblivion then meditate inside a singularity (Really you can :)).

Changes in this update include:

    Added new environment ' Black Beginning'
    Added new audio tracks
    Added free locomotion for xbox controller users(Rift)
    Performance improvements (Ongoing)
    Changed animal Ai so they don't run away from player
    Various fixes and tweaks


Another environment is in production with a new climate type and a host of new animals. I will update the 'update plan' on the discussions board with some more details on the current road map for NTVR. I will continue to support it and improve it.

As always if you have any issues, comments or suggestions please let me know and I will be sure to listen and take a look.

Thanks for supporting the project.

-John

notes.title: NEW UPDATE RELEASED: New environment 'Blue Deep'
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/6c5cb54f89a7012e2f93261831e91552f5b73268.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/e441b167b51d58f281563453ed32980a3232582a.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822959/7d9b4e88890341d9408a4493bb64a444689dc62e.jpg

Hello Everybody,

The new 'Blue Deep' underwater environment is now available. 

I wanted to spend some more time on this but I've been working long hours on it and am pretty worn out. Will be taking a week or so off to spend with my family.

As I mentioned previously this has been in development for some time intended as a separate project. I will continue to add and polish this and all the other environments.

You can explore the environment and discover a host of ocean life including dolphins, turtles, sword fish, sharks, manta ray, Orca, Jelly fish, sea horses, a variety of smaller schools. Plus get up close to the largest animal ever, the blue whale.

Warning: There are over 1000 fish in the environment and it can get resource demanding.

The creator orbs allow you to control huge schools of fish and create a lively sea bed with kelp forests and seaweed.

There is also a couple of wrecks to discover.

As for the other environments some new animals have been added including some Gorillas, Leopards, Snow Leopards and Linx.

Changes in this update include:


    Added new environment ' Blue Deep'
    Added gorilla to 'white waterfall'
    Added leopards to 'white waterfall'
 Added snow leopards to 'white winter'
 Added Linx to 'white winter'


Also contains various other minor tweaks and improvements

As always if you have any issues, comments or suggestions please let me know and I will be sure to listen and take a look.

Thanks for supporting the project.

-John

notes.notes:

Hi Everyone,

Its been a while in the making but the locomotion update is finally here. A day earlier than planned which is unusual, surprising what you can do with no sleep.

When the freedom locomotion system is released I will take a look at integrating it into Nature Treks, so that might include an arm swinger type locomotion system. But for now you at least have the freedom to explore the environments.

 More audio and audio visualisation effects

-John

  Place a variety of flowers
  Place a variety of rocks
  Control time of day
  Control weather

  Summon lotus enclosure to help your breathing pace

Other features, improvements and fixes include:

notes.title: UPDATE: Fixes for OculusSDK
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody.

Not a very glamorous update I'm afraid.
A fix for OculusSDK users and another water update(thus the large patch size)
The water has transparency and also supports buoyancy which will be important as we add interaction to the environments (throwing/floating objects).

Excluding any issues that crop up I would like to shift focus toward a major content update next. Including alternative movement and some additional locations.

Thanks to Oculus users for your patience this week.


    Fixed oculusSDK support
    Added new water with transparency and buoyancy properties.
